subject.title: fix(mcp): standalone apps stop hanging on stalled gateway requests

question: Should a shared MCP catalog refresh be aborted as soon as its final operation waiter detaches, rather than being allowed to finish for cache warming or connection reuse?
rationale: The patch makes a deliberate lifecycle/availability tradeoff that tests and one successful live run cannot determine as a permanent runtime ownership contract.

options.title: Confirm final-waiter cancellation
options.body: Accept the branch semantics: abort an in-flight shared catalog refresh once no operation still depends on it, then merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Retain background refreshes
options.body: Keep shared catalog loads independent of individual operation waiters if connection reuse or cache warming is required, and revise the cancellation ownership accordingly.

recommendation.title: Confirm final-waiter cancellation
recommendation.body: Accept the branch semantics: abort an in-flight shared catalog refresh once no operation still depends on it, then merge after exact-head checks pass.
